src/browser-console-panel.ts.name: Console show/hide
src/browser-console-panel.ts.description: Wires the top-bar toggle that shows or hides the developer console and remembers the choice.

src/browser-cvm-settings.ts.name: CVM discovery section
src/browser-cvm-settings.ts.description: Draws the ContextVM discovery section where the developer finds, edits and saves server families; saving reloads the page.

src/browser-devtools.ts.name: Developer console and log
src/browser-devtools.ts.description: Renders the developer console panels and the filterable message log, hiding NAP-CONFIG values and logging shell-to-napplet traffic.

src/browser-gamepad-indicators.ts.name: Gamepad indicators
src/browser-gamepad-indicators.ts.description: Shows connected game controllers and their activity in the top bar, whether or not a napplet listens.

src/browser-relay-panel.ts.name: Relay receipts panel
src/browser-relay-panel.ts.description: Counts events received per relay, grouped by why each read was routed, and draws the Relays sidebar with a reset button.

src/browser-resource-settings.ts.name: Resource servers section
src/browser-resource-settings.ts.description: Lets the developer save extra resource servers in the sidebar, keeping them for this session only when storage is unavailable.

src/browser-security-settings.ts.name: Nested-frame lock switch
src/browser-security-settings.ts.description: Lets the developer override the experimental nested-context lock (on, off or auto) from the page.

src/browser-sidebar-sections.ts.name: Sidebar fold memory
src/browser-sidebar-sections.ts.description: Remembers which sidebar sections are open or closed, separately from real settings.
